title: MMRAG-RFT: Two-stage Reinforcement Fine-tuning for Explainable Multi-modal Retrieval-augmented Generation
authors: Shengwei Zhao; Jingwen Yao; Sitong Wei; Linhai Xu; Yuying Liu; Dong Zhang; Zhiqiang Tian; Shaoyi Du
why_relevant: Proposes RL-based two-stage fine-tuning for multimodal RAG with ranking and answer generation, which marginally touches filtering irrelevant documents.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on explainability and accuracy via RL fine-tuning, not on robustness, conflict, adversarial, calibration, or uncertainty under unreliable evidence.
